name: io.github.Skyrxin/sast-mcp-server
title: SAST MCP Server
description: 11-scanner SAST/DAST MCP server with closed-loop remediation, SBOM/SARIF, and CI integrations

environmentVariables.name: SAST_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR (default: INFO).

environmentVariables.name: SAST_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional static API key to require auth (legacy mode; HTTP transports).

environmentVariables.name: SAST_MCP_JWT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional HMAC secret to require JWT auth with scopes (HTTP transports).
